# 03 Fix renderToSVG's initial siren-pending computation to enter-only

## Outcome

`renderToSVG` marks `siren-pending` only for elements that have an `enter` action in the resolved
timeline. Today it marks anything referenced *anywhere* in the timeline, which is now wrong: an
element whose only timeline action is `exit` or `highlight` must start visible, not hidden.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given a `PositionedGraph` fixture where node `X` has only an `exit` action (no `enter`),
  `renderToSVG` does not add `siren-pending` to `X`'s `<g>`.
- [ ] Given a fixture where node `Y` has only a `highlight` action, `Y` does not get
  `siren-pending`.
- [ ] Given a fixture where node `Z` has an `enter` action, `Z` still gets `siren-pending`
  (existing first-slice behavior preserved).
- [ ] All acceptance criteria from the first slice's renderer ticket continue to pass unmodified:
  node/edge group counts and `data-siren-id`, rect sizing, text centering (`x`/`y`/`text-anchor`/
  `dominant-baseline`), literal-text label safety, `marker-end`/`siren-arrow` defs, and root `svg`
  `width`/`height`/`viewBox` sizing — this ticket must not regress any of them.

## Test seam

`renderToSVG(graph: PositionedGraph): SVGSVGElement` — jsdom component test, hand-built
`PositionedGraph` fixtures, same pattern as the first slice.
